answer.reason: Beyond the summary, the verses tell only of his offering for Gad on the sixth day.

clauses.english: brought his offering for the tribe of Gad on the sixth day
clauses.quote: this was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel

doubts: NUM 2:14 gives his father as Reuel rather than Deuel; the clause does not depend on it.
